import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_CSV = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
X_text = train["comment_text"].astype(str)
y_labels = train[target_cols]
X_test_text = test["comment_text"].astype(str)
test_ids = test["id"]

X_full_text = pd.concat([X_text, X_test_text])
full_ids = pd.concat([train["id"], test_ids])

vec_final = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=50000, ngram_range=(1, 2), use_idf=True, min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
X_full_vec = vec_final.fit_transform(X_full_text)

X_train = X_full_vec[: len(train)]
X_test = X_full_vec[len(train) :]
y_train = y_labels

val_ratio = 0.2
train_size = int(X_train.shape[0] * (1 - val_ratio))
X_train_holdout = X_train[:train_size]
X_val_holdout = X_train[train_size:]
y_train_holdout = y_labels[:train_size]
y_val_holdout = y_labels[train_size:]

final_preds = np.zeros((len(test), len(target_cols)))
val_auc_scores = []

for i, col in enumerate(target_cols):
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        learning_rate=0.05,
        num_leaves=31,
        max_depth=-1,
        device="cpu",
        verbose=-1,
    )
    model.fit(
        X_train_holdout,
        y_train_holdout[col],
        eval_set=[(X_val_holdout, y_val_holdout[col])],
    )

    y_pred_val = model.predict_proba(X_val_holdout)[:, 1]
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val_holdout[col], y_pred_val)
    val_auc_scores.append(score)
    print(f"Validation AUC for {col}: {score:.4f}")

    preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    final_preds[:, i] = preds

mean_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
print(f"\nMean Validation AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "toxic": final_preds[:, 0],
        "severe_toxic": final_preds[:, 1],
        "obscene": final_preds[:, 2],
        "threat": final_preds[:, 3],
        "insult": final_preds[:, 4],
        "identity_hate": final_preds[:, 5],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_CSV, index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {SUBMISSION_CSV}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Validation Metric (Mean ROC AUC): {mean_auc:.4f}")
